content.comment_body: Hello! I’m experiencing an issue: after making several changes to my project, the main 'Home Page' no longer appears in [product_name] Web Editor. However, when I check the project directory, the main.html file is present and complete. How can I resolve this?
Screenshots wouldn’t help in your situation. You haven’t mentioned which [product_name] Web Editor version you are using. Please upload your project as a ZIP file for review.
I have attached the project. The [product_name] Web Editor version is [version_no]. Thank you.
It looks like your project file is corrupted. Please start a support request and share the project with [company_name].

I tested your [product_name] Web Editor project and also found it to be defective. Since only development can repair such issues, a support request is needed. There are improvements available in the latest [product_name] Web Editor [version_no], so I recommend updating. You need to uninstall your previous [product_name] Web Editor version first, as only one version can be installed on a PC. If you are not registered, registration is required to download the software due to export restrictions. When signing up, ensure you select the authorization for accessing export-restricted software. For reference, see: [url], [url].

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced an issue where the 'Home Page' would not display in the [product_name] Web Editor interface, even though the corresponding main.html file existed and was intact in the directory. Peer feedback and support responses indicated the project file was likely corrupted and advised submitting a service request for technical help. The discussion also pointed out that updating to the newest version after uninstalling the previous one could help. This situation emphasizes the need for better file integrity checks and transparent error messages within the editor.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the 'Home Page' to reliably appear within [product_name] Web Editor whenever the main file exists and is complete. They also anticipate receiving clear diagnostics or error feedback if a project file is damaged or unreadable.
